detail.longDescription: Kanboard 1.2.58 is out! This release fixes several security issues, so upgrading is recommended: • Stronger SSRF protection for webhooks and web links • Brute-force protection for 2FA codes • Empty LDAP passwords are now rejected • Comment visibility enforced in notifications and feeds Also new: an optional iCal feed that lists undated tasks as to-dos, many iCal fixes, and fewer third-party dependencies. https:// kanboard.org/releases/kanboard /v1.2.58.html # kanboard # opensource # selfhosting
